faq.subheading: Answers to the questions we hear most often before a project starts. Didn't find yours? Just ask us.

items.question: How much does a website cost?
items.answer: The price depends on the type of site, its scope, and features. You can find guideline prices in the Pricing section: for example, a landing page from $526 and a corporate website from $1,053. We give an exact quote after the brief and fix it in the contract.

items.question: How long does development take?
items.answer: On average, a landing page takes 1-2 weeks, a corporate website 3-5 weeks, and an online store from six weeks. Deadlines are set in the contract, and we share progress along the way.

items.question: Do you work with companies?
items.answer: Yes, we work with both individuals and legal entities. In either case, we sign a development contract.

items.question: What do you need from me to get started?
items.answer: Tell us about your business and the goals of the site, and show us a few examples you like. A logo, copy, and photos are helpful, but if you don't have them, we'll help prepare them.

items.question: Can I request changes?
items.answer: Yes. We agree on every stage with you: structure, design, and the finished build. Revisions within the agreed scope are included in the price.

items.question: Who will own the website?
items.answer: You will. After launch we hand over all access: domain, hosting, admin panel, and source code.

items.question: Do you help with promotion after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We can provide ongoing support, handle SEO, and set up Yandex Direct campaigns so your site brings in leads.

landing.bodyTitle: A turnkey landing page you can send ad traffic to right away
body: A landing page shows one service or one product and leads the visitor to one action: leave a request, call, buy. That is why it works well for ads and for testing a new offer: the visitor does not hunt through a menu, everything is on one page. If you have several directions, a [corporate website](/services/corporate) fits better, and a specialist or a small company can do with a [business card site](/services/vizitka).

We start with the structure: which blocks, in what order and what they say. Once it is agreed, we draw the design for computer and phone, then build it. At the end we connect the request form (to Telegram, email or CRM) and Yandex Metrika with goals, so you can see where requests come from.

Unique design without templates, in your brand style
Responsive for phones, tablets and large screens
Request form sending to Telegram, email or CRM
Analytics setup: Metrika, goals, click map
Loading speed and basic SEO preparation

faq.q: How long does it take to make a landing page?
faq.a: On average 1-2 weeks. It depends on how fast we agree on the structure and layout and whether you have ready texts and materials. Timelines are written in the contract.

faq.q: How is a landing page different from a multi-page site?
faq.a: A landing page tells about one product or service and leads to one action, while a corporate website describes the whole company: services, team, news. A landing page is quicker to make and better for ads; if you have several directions, a multi-page site is better.

faq.q: Do I need ready texts and photos?
faq.a: It helps but is not required. If there are no materials, we help prepare them: we structure the texts and suggest which photos are needed.

faq.q: Can a landing page be promoted in search?
faq.a: Yes. We include basic SEO preparation: titles, description, fast loading and markup. To rank in search it is better to have several pages for different queries, so a landing page is often complemented with separate service pages.

faq.q: Is WordPress better or worse than a custom-built site?

body: Search optimization brings to your site people who are already searching for your service: "order", "price", "turnkey". The work goes step by step: prepare the site technically (we start with an [SEO audit](/services/seo-audit)), collect queries, improve pages and texts, then watch the results and adjust the plan.

Once a month we send a report: what was done, how positions and traffic changed, what comes next. The result depends on competition in your niche and the state of the site, so we do not promise positions. We promise regular work and numbers that show what is happening. If you need requests right now, we add [Yandex Direct](/services/yandex-direct), and for a local business [Yandex Maps](/services/yandex-maps).

faq.q: How soon will there be results?
faq.a: First changes are usually visible after 2-3 months of work. The exact time depends on the age of the site, competition and how fast changes are made. We do not promise "top 1 in a week" and honestly show the dynamics in a monthly report.

faq.q: Do you guarantee getting to the top?
faq.a: No. Search engines do not reveal their algorithms and positions also depend on competitors, so an honest guaranteed top does not exist. We answer for what is in our hands: the work plan, the work itself and a monthly report.

faq.q: How is SEO different from contextual advertising?
faq.a: [Yandex Direct](/services/yandex-direct) ads bring visitors while you pay for clicks. SEO brings traffic from regular search results: it grows more slowly but does not require paying for each visit. They are often used together.

faq.q: Does the site have to be remade for promotion?
faq.a: Not always. First we audit and see what gets in the way: often technical fixes and new pages are enough. If the site is built so that it cannot be promoted, we will say so directly and offer options.

seo-audit.bodyTitle: SEO audit of a website: a report with priorities of fixes
body: An audit shows why pages are not indexed or do not grow in results, which errors get in the way of search robots and visitors and what to fix first. It is done before promotion, after a redesign or a move, and when traffic suddenly drops.

We check technical parameters (indexing, speed, mobile adaptation, duplicate pages, redirects, markup), structure and internal links, titles and texts, and compare the site with competitors. The report is written without complicated terms: what was found, how important it is, how to fix it. We can take over the fixes and move on to [SEO promotion](/services/seo) or [website support](/services/support).

faq.a: The cost depends on the size of the site and the depth of the check. We name the price after getting to know the site, when we understand the scope.

faq.q: What will I get after the audit?
faq.a: A report with the problems found, their importance and recommendations for fixing them. It is written in plain language so both a developer and a business owner can use it.

faq.q: Will you fix the errors found?
faq.a: If needed, yes. We can make the technical fixes and update the texts ourselves or hand the list to your developer.

faq.q: How is an audit different from promotion?
faq.a: An audit is a one-time check with a plan. Promotion is regular work on improving the site and tracking results. An audit is often the first step before promotion.

faq.q: Do you need access to the site?
faq.a: For a basic check the site address is enough. For a deep audit, access to Yandex Metrika, Webmaster and Search Console helps: real data on traffic and indexing becomes visible.

body: Direct shows ads to people who are searching for your service right now, and the first visitors arrive on the day of launch. Without a proper setup the budget goes to irrelevant clicks, so most of the work is queries, negative keywords and goals in Metrika.

First we calculate a budget forecast and the cost of a request. Then we collect queries, split ads into groups, write ads and set up goals so you can see which ads bring requests. After launch we switch off what does not work, test texts and send reports with spend and cost per request. It is best to send visitors to a page made for the query, for example a [landing page](/services/landing), while a long-term flow comes from [SEO promotion](/services/seo).

faq.q: What budget is needed to start?

faq.q: When will the first requests come?
faq.a: Usually in the first days after launch: ads are shown right after moderation. A stable result comes after optimization, once ineffective queries and texts are removed.

faq.q: How is Direct different from SEO?
faq.a: Direct is paid ads: you pay for clicks, the result is fast. [SEO](/services/seo) is work on positions in regular results: the result comes more slowly but does not require paying for each visit. They are often combined.

faq.q: Whose name is the ad account registered in?
faq.a: We recommend registering the account in your name: this way the history of campaigns and data stay with you even if you change contractors. We agree on the details at the brief.

faq.q: How is Google Ads different from Yandex Direct?

faq.q: Do I need a separate page for foreign clients?
faq.a: Yes, it is better to send ads to a page in the language of the audience, with a clear offer and a request form. We will prepare a [landing page](/services/landing) for the right market.

vk-ads.bodyTitle: VKontakte targeting where you can see what a request costs
body: Targeted advertising shows an ad to people who match the portrait of your client: by age, city, interests, communities and behavior on the site. It works where a person is not yet searching for your service but may want it: online schools, beauty salons, home goods, local services. Ads are shown on VKontakte and on other VK Ads placements.

We start with the client portrait and hypotheses: which audiences and which offers to test. Then we make ads in different formats (post, carousel, clip, lead form) and connect the pixel and goals so you see requests, not only clicks. We launch several combinations on a small budget, switch off the weak ones, strengthen the working ones and bring visitors back with retargeting. Requests are easier to collect on a page made for the offer, for example a [landing page](/services/landing), while clients who are already searching for your service come from [Yandex Direct](/services/yandex-direct).

Audiences: interests, communities, keywords, a client base and lookalike audiences
Ad texts and layouts for posts, carousels, clips and lead forms

Retargeting for those who visited the site or viewed the ad
Ad labelling and reports: spend, requests, cost per request

You need requests from the social network: bookings, inquiries, leads for an online course or a store

steps.title: Brief and client portrait
steps.text: We study the product, clients and competitors, form hypotheses and forecast the budget.

steps.title: Preparation

steps.title: Labelling and launch

faq.q: How much does VKontakte targeting setup cost?
faq.a: We calculate management after the brief: it depends on the number of audiences, formats and the scope of work. The advertising budget that VK Ads charges is paid separately; we make a forecast at the analysis stage.

faq.q: What budget is needed to start?
faq.a: One that collects enough data for conclusions in a week or two: the cost of a request cannot be judged by the first days. The size depends on the niche and the price of impressions; at the brief we make a forecast.

faq.q: When will the first requests come?
faq.a: Ads are shown after moderation, and the first requests usually come in the first days. A stable cost per request is visible after a week or two, when enough data has collected and the weak combinations are switched off.

faq.q: How is targeting different from Yandex Direct?
faq.a: [Direct](/services/yandex-direct) shows ads to people who are searching for a service right now. Targeting shows an ad to a suitable audience even if the person searched for nothing, and helps find new clients. They are often used together.

faq.q: Is ad labelling required?
faq.a: Yes, online advertising in Russia is labelled: every ad has a token (ERID), and data about the ad is passed to an advertising data operator. We arrange the labelling together with you; the details depend on who is the advertiser: a company, a sole proprietor or a self-employed person.

telegram-ads.bodyTitle: Telegram advertising seen by the readers of the right channels
body: Telegram Ads shows short ads in channels and in Telegram search, where your audience reads news and niche posts. An ad takes up to 160 characters and leads to a channel, a bot or a website, so the result depends on choosing the audience precisely and on a strong offer. Channels can be chosen by topic and language, set as a list and excluded.

We start with the audience and a budget forecast, then write the texts by the rules of the platform: ads are checked manually and a weak text is sent back. We connect the Telegram pixel and UTM tags so you see requests and subscribers, not only impressions. After launch we compare channels and texts, switch off ineffective ones and strengthen the working ones. If the ad leads to a chat, it is convenient to connect a [Telegram bot](/services/telegram-bots) that takes requests, and the overall flow of clients is complemented by [VKontakte targeting](/services/vk-ads).

You sell a service or a product to an audience that reads niche channels
You want to lead people to a Telegram bot that takes requests

steps.title: Preparation
steps.text: We set up the account, write ads by the rules of the platform, install the pixel and UTM tags and arrange the labelling.

steps.title: Moderation and launch

steps.text: We compare channels and texts, switch off the weak ones, strengthen the working ones and test new combinations.

faq.q: How much does advertising in Telegram cost?
faq.a: We calculate management after the brief. The advertising budget is paid separately: Telegram Ads charges per thousand impressions, and the minimum bids and the way to top up are set by the platform and change over time, so we name the current figures at the brief.

faq.q: Where are ads shown and how do I choose the audience?
faq.a: Ads are shown in channels and in Telegram search. We choose channels by topic and language or make a list of specific ones and exclude the unwanted. Which other settings are available is decided by the platform; we discuss them at the brief.

faq.q: Why might an ad be rejected?
faq.a: Telegram checks every ad manually and strictly: you cannot promise "the best", press with calls to action, or overuse capital letters and emoji. We write texts by the rules of the platform and rework them if an ad is returned.

faq.q: Is ad labelling required in Telegram?
faq.a: Yes, advertising in the Russian internet is labelled: the advertiser data is entered in the account and the token (ERID) is added to the ad. We arrange this together with you.

faq.q: How is Telegram advertising different from Direct and VKontakte targeting?
faq.a: [Yandex Direct](/services/yandex-direct) brings people who search for a service, [VKontakte targeting](/services/vk-ads) shows ads to the wide audience of the social network, and Telegram Ads reaches the readers of niche channels. We will choose a combination for your task.

body: A person searches for "cafe nearby" or "tire service" and Yandex shows a map of organizations. A card with photos, opening hours, current contacts and fresh reviews gets more calls and routes. For a local business this often matters more than the site's positions in regular search.

We create or update the card in Yandex Business, check the company data, add photos, services and products and help build work with reviews. Then we set up ads on the maps and link the card to the site and analytics so you can see calls and visits. The result depends on competition in your area and the quality of your services. To be found in regular search too, we add [SEO promotion](/services/seo).

faq.q: What is Yandex Business?
faq.a: It is a Yandex service for companies: you manage the organization card, reply to reviews, run ads and see statistics of impressions, calls and routes.

faq.q: Can I be promoted on Maps without a website?
faq.a: Yes, an organization card works without a site. But a site adds trust and information, so it is better to have both.

faq.q: How do ads in Yandex Maps work?
faq.a: Your organization is shown higher or more prominently in map search results. The payment terms are set by Yandex's ad system; we take on the setup and analysis of results.

faq.q: How can reviews be influenced?
faq.a: Faking reviews is not allowed: it breaks the rules and leads to sanctions. You can calmly ask satisfied clients to leave a review and reply to all reviews, including negative ones - it works for your reputation.

faq.q: Does it suit a business without an office?
faq.a: If clients search for you near them, for example a mobile service with a service area, then yes. If the business is fully online, it is better to work with search and online advertising.

faq.q: Can an existing CMS be connected?

faq.q: How much does it cost to create a Telegram bot?
faq.a: The cost depends on features: a simple bot for taking requests costs less, a store with payment and an admin panel costs more. We name the price after the brief, when the scenarios are clear.

faq.q: How long does it take to develop a bot?
faq.a: A simple bot can be done faster; a complex one with payment and integrations takes longer. We name the timeline after the brief and fix it in the contract.

faq.q: Do clients need to install anything?
faq.a: No, the bot works in Telegram: just open the chat and press "Start".

faq.q: Can payment be accepted in the bot?
faq.a: Yes, we connect payment services that support payment in Telegram. We will pick an option for your business and legal form.

faq.q: Bot or mini app - what is the difference?
faq.a: A bot holds a dialogue in the chat with buttons and messages. A mini app is a full interface inside Telegram, like a site or an app. For complex scenarios, such as a catalog with a cart, a mini app is often more convenient; we will advise at the brief.

telegram-mini-apps.name: Telegram Mini Apps

telegram-mini-apps.metaTitle: Telegram Mini Apps development to order - KEL Studio
telegram-mini-apps.metaDescription: Telegram mini apps: stores, accounts, bookings and services inside the messenger. Integration with a bot, payment and your system.
telegram-mini-apps.short: Apps inside Telegram: catalog, booking, client account, payment and integrations.
telegram-mini-apps.lead: We build Telegram Mini Apps: applications that open right in the messenger and look like a full service. A catalog with a cart, booking, a personal account, payment.
telegram-mini-apps.bodyTitle: A Telegram Mini App: a service inside the messenger
body: A Mini App opens inside Telegram from a bot button or a link. Nothing to download and no registration: Telegram passes the profile data, and payment and notifications go through the messenger. So the client gets a catalog, a form or an account that will not fit into chat buttons.

We design the interface in the style of Telegram and your brand, write the client and server parts, and connect the bot, payment and your accounting system. If you already have a site or service, we can make its version inside Telegram. For simple scenarios a [Telegram bot](/services/telegram-bots) is enough.
includes: An interface in the style of Telegram and your brand
Authorization through Telegram without registration
Link with the bot: launch button, notifications
Catalog, cart, booking, personal account - for your task
Payment and integrations with CRM, a database and the site
An admin panel for managing content
fit: A chat bot is no longer enough: you need a catalog, a cart or an account
You want to give clients a service without installing an app
You have a site or service used mostly from a phone

steps.title: Brief
steps.text: We define the task, audience and features of the mini app and look at what you already have.

steps.title: Prototype

faq.q: How is a mini app different from a bot?
faq.a: A bot communicates with messages and buttons. A mini app is a full interface inside Telegram with a catalog, forms and an account. They are often used together: the bot invites the user to open the app.

faq.q: Do I need to download an app?
faq.a: No. The mini app opens in Telegram itself, nothing needs to be installed.

faq.q: How much does mini app development cost?
faq.a: The cost depends on features and integrations. We name the price after the brief and analysis of scenarios.

faq.q: Can payments be accepted?
faq.a: Yes, through payment services that Telegram supports. We will pick a suitable option.

faq.q: Can an existing site be moved into a mini app?
faq.a: In many cases yes: we adapt the interface to the Telegram format and connect authorization through the messenger. First we look at your site and propose the scope of changes.

web3.title: Web3 development: smart contracts and dApps
web3.metaTitle: Web3 development: smart contracts and dApps to order - KEL Studio
web3.metaDescription: Web3 projects: Solidity smart contracts, decentralized applications (dApps), wallet connection, interfaces. Estimate after the brief.
web3.short: Smart contracts, dApps and interfaces for blockchain projects.
web3.lead: We develop smart contracts in Solidity, decentralized applications (dApps) and interfaces that connect wallets. First a prototype on a test network, then a full launch.
web3.bodyTitle: Web3 development: smart contracts and interfaces for them
body: In Web3 applications data and rules are stored on a blockchain, so there is no single server that can be switched off. The basis is smart contracts: programs that run automatically and need no intermediary. Tokens, exchanges, marketplaces and loyalty programs are built on them.

We write contracts in Solidity and build the dApp and web interface: we connect wallets, show data from the network and build transactions. Before publication we test the logic and scenarios, because a published contract is hard and costly to fix. For the other parts of the product, such as an account or an admin panel, we add a [web application](/services/web-apps).
includes: Architecture design: what to keep on the network and what off it
Smart contracts in Solidity
Testing contracts and scenarios before publication
A dApp and web interface with wallet connection
Integration with the network, blockchain data and your backend
Documentation and handover of the project to the team
fit: You launch a token, a marketplace or a service on a blockchain
You need an interface to work with your smart contracts
You want to test an idea on a prototype before big development

steps.title: Idea analysis and architecture
steps.text: We find out what must happen on the network and off it, and choose the blockchain and approach.

steps.title: Prototype
steps.text: We build a first version of the contracts and interface to test the idea on a test network.

steps.title: Contract and dApp development
steps.text: We write smart contracts and the interface and connect wallets and data from the network.

steps.title: Testing
steps.text: We check logic, edge cases and user scenarios before publication.

steps.title: Launch and support
steps.text: We publish the contracts, launch the app and help with further changes.

faq.q: What is a smart contract?
faq.a: A program stored on a blockchain that automatically carries out set conditions: for example, transfers tokens after payment. It cannot be quietly changed, so the logic must be thought through and tested before publication.

faq.q: Which networks do you work with?
faq.a: Most often with Ethereum-compatible (EVM) networks. The choice depends on the task, fees and audience, and we discuss it at the brief.

faq.q: How much does Web3 development cost?
faq.a: It depends on the complexity of contracts and the interface. We estimate after the brief and splitting the project into stages.

faq.q: Can we start with a prototype?
faq.a: Yes, it is a sensible path: first we test the idea on a test network and an interface prototype, and only then invest in a full product.

faq.q: Do you build only contracts or the site too?
faq.a: Both: smart contracts, the user interface and integration with your system.

parsing.metaDescription: Order parsing: automatic data collection from websites and marketplaces, competitor price monitoring. Export to Excel, a database or an API. From 30,000 ₽.
parsing.short: Automatic collection of prices, catalogs and listings exported to a table, database or API.
parsing.lead: We collect data from websites and deliver it to Excel, Google Sheets, a database or through an API: competitor prices, supplier catalogs, listings. From 30,000 ₽; first result from a few days.
parsing.bodyTitle: Data parsing to order: prices, catalogs, listings
body: A parser visits pages, takes the fields you need (price, name, availability, contacts, reviews) and puts them into a table or a database. This lets you track competitor prices, collect supplier catalogs, fill your own [online store](/services/ecommerce) and find new listings without manual work.

We write a parser for your task: we define sources and fields, clean the data, bring it to a single format and set up scheduled runs. We can report changes in Telegram through a [bot](/services/telegram-bots). We collect only publicly available data and respect the rules of the source sites.
includes: Data collection from websites, marketplaces and aggregators
Cleaning and bringing to a single format
Export to Excel, Google Sheets, a database or an API
Scheduled runs and monitoring of changes
Telegram notifications when data changes
Working with anti-block protection within the sites' rules
fit: You need to watch competitor prices and react in time
A supplier's catalog arrives in an inconvenient form
You collect by hand data that could be collected automatically

steps.title: Task definition
steps.text: We clarify sources, which fields are needed, how often to collect and in what form to receive.

steps.title: Source check
steps.text: We look at how the sites are built, whether there are limits and protection, and estimate volume and complexity.

steps.title: Parser development
steps.text: We write the collector, cleaning and conversion of data to a single format.

steps.title: Test export
steps.text: We show the result on real data and refine fields and format.

steps.title: Launch and maintenance
steps.text: We set up regular runs and notifications and make sure the parser keeps working when the site changes.

faq.q: How much does parsing cost?
faq.a: Parsing starts from 30,000 ₽. The price depends on the number of sources, the complexity of the sites, the data volume and whether regular scheduled runs are needed. We name it after clarifying the task.

faq.q: Is it legal to parse websites?
faq.a: Collecting publicly available information is acceptable, but you must consider the rules of the source site, copyright on content and personal data law. We collect only publicly available data and discuss the source's limits in advance.

faq.q: Which sites can be parsed?
faq.a: Online stores, supplier catalogs, marketplaces, aggregators, directories, classified boards and maps of organizations. Complexity depends on the site's protection, so we check the source first.

faq.q: In what form will I get the data?
faq.a: In Excel or CSV, in Google Sheets, in a database or through an API. We can add Telegram notifications when data changes.

faq.q: What if the site changes and the parser breaks?
faq.a: We can take the parser on maintenance: watch changes on the source site and update the collector so that data keeps coming.

support.bodyTitle: Website support: who looks after the site after launch
body: After launch a site needs system and plugin updates, backups, availability monitoring, edits of texts and prices and new features. If nobody does this, the site becomes outdated, opens more slowly and becomes vulnerable.

We support sites made by us and by other studios: technical maintenance, small edits, improvements, [redesign](/services/design), moving to another hosting, domain or platform, for example to [WordPress](/services/wordpress). First we look at your site and propose a format: monthly support or separate tasks.
includes: Site availability monitoring and error control
System and plugin updates, protection from hacking
Regular backups and the ability to restore
Edits: texts, prices, banners, new pages
Feature improvements: forms, integrations, personal account, catalog
Redesign and moving the site to another hosting, domain or platform
fit: The site was made by a freelancer or studio that is no longer in touch
You need regular edits and have no in-house developer
The site is outdated, slow or looks poor on a phone

steps.title: Work by tasks

steps.title: Report

faq.q: How much does website support cost?
faq.a: It depends on the platform, the size of the site and the scope of work: some need only updates and backups, others regular improvements. We name the price after getting to know the site.

faq.q: Do you support sites made by others?
faq.a: Yes. First we look at the code, platform, access and state of the site, and then we start work.

faq.q: What is a redesign and when is it needed?
faq.a: A redesign is an update of the look and structure of a site. It is needed if the site looks outdated, is inconvenient on a phone, poorly turns visitors into requests or does not match the brand.

faq.q: How is a site moved to another hosting or domain?
faq.a: We copy the site and database to the new place, check it works, set up addresses and redirects to keep search positions, and only then switch the domain.

faq.q: Can I order separate edits without a support contract?
faq.a: Yes. You can set separate tasks: an edit, a feature improvement or a redesign. If edits are needed regularly, monthly support is more convenient.

faq.q: Why are the prices "from"?

faq.q: What is included in the price of a site?
faq.a: The scope depends on the service and is written in the contract: usually design, development, content and launch. What exactly is included in your case we clarify at the brief.

faq.q: Do I have to pay for anything after launch?
faq.a: The site belongs to you once handed over. Regular costs are the domain and hosting with a provider you choose and, if you wish, support and promotion. We list everything you will need in advance.

faq.q: Can I order only part of the work, for example design?
